card.title: Request an Exception
card.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we can discover whether it harms the form.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Next time we won't be discussing an untested idea.

mechanism: A obtains a first deadline extension so later requests can cite an already tested exception.
confusable: Unlike asking only for more time, A frames the concession as precedent from the beginning.
comparison: An experimental extension differs from documenting a rainy-day admission for a new caf? worker.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
